record.paper_title: Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs
record.original_question: Characterize the family of join graphs G + H for which ψ_q(G + H) = 1, where G + H is the join of two graphs obtained from their disjoint union by adding every edge between a vertex of G and a vertex of H.

evidence.quote: 2. Characterize the family of graphs G + H for which ψq(G + H) = 1.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G = (V, E) be a finite simple graph. For a vertex v ∈ V, let N[v] denote its closed neighborhood (i.e., v together with all its neighbors). A quorum coloring of G is a partition π = {V_1, V_2, …, V_k} of V into nonempty color classes such that for every vertex v ∈ V, at least half of the vertices of N[v] lie in the same class as v. The quorum coloring number ψ_q(G) is the maximum number of classes in any quorum coloring of G; equivalently, ψ_q(G) = 1 means that the only quorum coloring of G is the trivial one with a single color class.

Given two vertex-disjoint graphs G and H, their join G + H is the graph with vertex set V(G) ∪ V(H) and edge set E(G) ∪ E(H) ∪ {uv : u ∈ V(G), v ∈ V(H)}.

Problem. Characterize the family of join graphs G + H for which ψ_q(G + H) = 1.
artifact.status_search_result: A 2021 paper titled "Solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs" addresses open problems posed earlier on this topic. It is not clear from publicly available abstracts whether the specific characterization of joins G + H with ψ_q(G + H) = 1 was fully resolved there or only partially addressed; complexity-theoretic obstructions (related to NP ∩ co-NP) suggest that a full characterization of graphs with ψ_q = 1 is unlikely in general. The status of the join-restricted version is not conclusively determined by the search.

status_evidence.snippet: Paper announcing solutions to four open problems on quorum colorings of graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Some previously open quorum coloring problems were resolved, but the abstract does not confirm whether the join characterization is fully completed.

status_evidence.title: On some open problems concerning quorum colorings of graphs
status_evidence.snippet: There is no good characterization of the graphs G with ψq(G) = 1 unless P = NP ∩ co-NP; known families with ψ_q = 1 include K_{2n+1} and K_r + K_s with r+s odd and r ≥ 2.
status_evidence.claim: A general characterization of graphs with quorum coloring number 1 is unlikely; only partial families are known.
